items.rationale: Clauses 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) exclude translation costs incurred to substantiate the claim, even when the police report is required for cover.
Clauses 7.1.8(e) and 7.1.8(f) exclude the provider’s working materials and surcharges associated with the translation.

items.description: Robbery compensation for watch and cash
items.rationale: The reported armed robbery is covered under 2.3 and 11.1, subject to itemisation under 7.1.10. The watch is estimated at the €2,500 per-item cap and the cash reaches its €500 cap; the €5,000 away-from-home limit does not reduce the subtotal, and the single €50 deductible leaves €2,950.
Clause 7.1.8(b) excludes forwarding and shipping charges even when they appear on the same statement as covered property compensation.
